sources.prompt: Create one exquisite FULL COLOR narrative illustration for a Chinese Dream of the Red Chamber motion comic. Landscape 1536x1024. Rich Qing-dynasty gongbi heavy mineral colors with refined modern Chinese manhua facial drawing, azurite blue, malachite green, cinnabar, antique gold, silk textiles, nuanced natural light. Full-bleed painting, no text, no captions, no border, no logos or watermark. Strong cinematic composition with foreground/midground/background. Expressive believable hands and faces, fully clothed and nonsexual. Delicate ink contours, painterly foliage, polished illustrated-book quality. Scene: the Begonia Poetry Club in Daguanyuan, chapter 37. A group of five fully clothed young Chinese noblewomen in elegant Qing literary-fantasy robes, and one young nobleman in cinnabar robe. They compose poetry around a dark carved rosewood table with blank rice paper, brushes, white begonia in porcelain. Lin Daiyu in pale celadon with blush sash on the center-right; Baochai in warm cream and gold; Tanchun in coral. Open airy scholarly hall, turquoise painted beams, bamboo and white begonia courtyard beyond. The writing hands and quiet exchanged looks center the composition. Rich jade, vermilion, porcelain blue and warm afternoon light. Poetic intimacy, never modern props.
